annotations.title: News about one country (flag emoji + country keywords) with counts and top topics

description:
News about one country (flag emoji + country keywords) with counts and top topics. Items of the last N hours (1-168, default 24; importance all|high|medium|low) that carry the country's flag emoji or mention it (e.g. RU: Russia/Kremlin/Bank of Russia/MOEX; US: USA/Fed/White House): count, high_count, share_of_window, top_topics and the 10 latest headlines.

GET /news/country — price $0.004 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, RU, CN, UA, IR, GB; UK = GB; EU accepted)

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168) Default: 24.
